articles.title: USC hosts first clubs fair for non-USC-ratified clubs
articles.summary: At the USC's first fair for clubs run under other Western bodies, our co-president Dilnazz Matharu talks about how much harder it used to be for a faculty club like ours to get noticed on campus.

articles.title: Students bring diverse stories, health education to young readers
articles.summary: How the club started, the four books so far (from The Girl Under the Rambutan Tree to MicroVille's microbiome characters and a new story about pre-game nerves), donations to Children's Hospital at LHSC and to kids in Guyana, and a book in the works with Dr. Jamaica Cass.

articles.title: These students are bringing diversity to children's literature, one book at a time
articles.summary: Western students are writing and illustrating picture books through a multicultural lens, so more kids can find people like themselves in the stories and media they grow up with.

articles.title: Science students create, donate books tackling representation
articles.summary: A group of Western science students make picture books that bring marginalized stories to young readers, then donate copies to libraries across London.
